forbidden: expected E2 primary or secondary prediction
mutation operator id, name, class, description, or repair
precomputed mutation patch metadata or generator edit script
source line number alone as lineage proof
required: language parser/tokenizer output produced from those bytes

application_sequence: Implement transport engine and independent checker without opening the 58 candidate revisions.
Pass the separately frozen mutation-free transport qualification contract.
Generate and freeze a sanitized opaque 58-case admission manifest containing only allowlisted fields and candidate source hashes; do not run transport yet.
Only after admission freeze, expose candidate bytes to the transport engine and run two deterministic blind transport replays plus independent checking.
Freeze all 58 transport receipts and aggregate status before reading mutation truth/operator metadata/expected E2 predictions.
Only then authorize candidate D1/D2/D3 overlay materialization using frozen transport observations.
A3/A4 verdict logic remains separately unauthorized until all-58 overlay qualification is frozen.

baseline_context_freeze_algorithm.alpha_boundary_pair: Apply the same deterministic minimization over alpha_key tokens.
baseline_context_freeze_algorithm.lexical_boundary_pair: Enumerate suffix length L before the anchor and prefix length R after the anchor within the smallest parser-owned executable scope containing the anchor. Choose the pair that uniquely brackets the anchor in that canonical scope and minimizes (L+R, max(L,R), L) lexicographically. Scope boundaries are valid zero-length boundaries only when the anchor touches entry/exit.
baseline_context_freeze_algorithm.scope: For each frozen anchor, context windows are derived from canonical seed bytes only; candidate bytes may not influence which baseline context is chosen.
baseline_context_freeze_algorithm.structural_hole_context: Starting at the anchor parent and expanding outward, replace the anchor child/subtree with HOLE. Choose the smallest normalized ancestor-with-HOLE fingerprint unique in the canonical file; ties are broken by ancestor depth then canonical child index.
baseline_context_freeze_algorithm.structural_subtree: Freeze the normalized structural fingerprint of the exact parser node corresponding to the canonical anchor.

binding_slot_transport.rule: If guard_comparison lineage is PRESENT and realization is ROLE_COMPATIBLE, bind expected_coordinate and current_coordinate to candidate comparison operands using the frozen operand_index values. Identifier spelling, symbol names, and value equality are not used.
binding_slot_transport.scope: Only the two frozen guard operand slots are transported.

core_separation.critical_non_invariant: Baseline control/dataflow relations among guard, rejection, and effect anchors are NEVER hard constraints for transport. Reordering, bypass, guard removal, helper extraction, and effect-before-guard must remain observable rather than being filtered out by transport.
core_separation.downstream_semantics: A3/A4 may later consume frozen transport observations, but transport itself never decides preservation, regression, safety, guardedness, dominance, ordering, or consequence equivalence.
core_separation.realization_semantics: After lineage is resolved, syntax realization is reported separately as ROLE_COMPATIBLE, ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE, COMPOSITE_EDIT_REGION, or NO_REALIZATION.
core_separation.transport_semantics: Transport establishes source-edit lineage only: which candidate source region, if any, descends from the frozen canonical anchor.

determinism_and_content_addressing.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted object keys, separators(',', ':'), final newline prohibited for digest preimage unless the emitting schema explicitly says otherwise.
determinism_and_content_addressing.receipt_digest: sha256(canonical receipt with transport_digest_sha256 field omitted)

downstream_handshake.transport_complete_absent: Must be preserved as an explicit proven-absence observation; it may not be silently converted to generic assurance-incomplete.
downstream_handshake.transport_complete_present_role_compatib: May be consumed by candidate D3 materialization.
downstream_handshake.transport_complete_present_role_incompat: Must be preserved as an explicit anchor-realization observation; downstream logic may reason about it only after transport freeze.
downstream_handshake.transport_incomplete: Downstream definitive A3/A4 verdict for that case is forbidden.

lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_ABSENT_BY_EDIT_LINEAGE: Unique deletion lineage established under the strict deletion rule; this is an observation, not a consequence verdict.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES: Two or more admissible descendant regions remain.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS_WITNESS_DISAGREEMENT: Independent satisfied witness clauses identify different regions.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_PARSE_INVALID: Candidate cannot be parsed sufficiently to establish stable code regions.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_PRESENT_EDIT_DESCENDANT: Unique descendant region established through edit/structural lineage but bytes changed or moved.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_PRESENT_EXACT: Unique descendant established and candidate bytes exactly realize the frozen anchor slice.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_UNRESOLVED: No admissible present or deletion proof is established.
lineage_statuses.TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED: Language/construct/encoding is outside frozen transport support.

multi_anchor_consistency.effect_roles_share_one_transport: EFFECT_BOUNDARY and SUCCESS_OUTCOME remain two roles on the single effect_applied anchor; they are never independently searched.
multi_anchor_consistency.injectivity: Distinct anchor keys may not resolve to the same candidate lineage region unless the frozen contract explicitly aliases them. The six current seed contracts contain no such cross-anchor alias.
multi_anchor_consistency.whole_case_status: COMPLETE only when each anchor has a non-ambiguous lineage status (PRESENT or proven ABSENT), parser support is valid, and any available binding slot is deterministically resolved. Any ambiguous/unresolved/unsupported anchor makes the case TRANSPORT_INCOMPLETE.

resolution_without_scores.agreement_rule: Compute every satisfied P1-P4 clause. If zero clauses are satisfied, PRESENT is not established. If all satisfied clauses identify one canonical candidate lineage region, PRESENT is established. If two satisfied clauses identify different regions, result is TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS_WITNESS_DISAGREEMENT; no priority ordering may hide the disagreement.
resolution_without_scores.candidate_sets: Each witness returns a set of candidate lineage regions or no evidence. Empty evidence from an inapplicable witness does not count against another witness; a witness that yields multiple regions remains explicitly multi-valued.
resolution_without_scores.deletion_rule: TRANSPORT_ABSENT_BY_EDIT_LINEAGE requires W2 and W3 each to resolve uniquely to the same zero-realization deletion gap, valid parsing of the containing executable scope after deletion, and no satisfied PRESENT clause anywhere in the candidate file. A single missing exact match is never deletion evidence.
resolution_without_scores.multi_candidate_rule: If the strongest available evidence remains multi-valued and no other satisfied clause reduces all admissible candidates to one region, result is TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES.
present_support_clauses: P1: W1 resolves to exactly one code region.
P2: W2 resolves to exactly one edit region.
P3: W3 and at least one of W4/W5 each resolve uniquely and their regions are the same parser realization or canonically nested descriptions of the same edit region.
P4: W4 and W5 each resolve uniquely and agree on the same parser realization; this is the only structure-only move/alpha-rename clause.
resolution_without_scores.unsupported_rule: Tokenizer/parser inability, unsupported encoding, or control-independent syntax recovery that cannot give stable regions yields TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED or TRANSPORT_PARSE_INVALID, never a guessed anchor.

scientific_question: Given a frozen canonical consequence anchor and a candidate revision descended from that canonical seed, can the descendant source region be identified from mutation-blind source provenance alone, without using mutation identity, expected truth, E2 prediction, or downstream consequence outcome?

syntax_realization_after_lineage.COMPOSITE_EDIT_REGION: Lineage is present but the edit envelope contains multiple sibling executable regions and cannot be reduced to one realization.
syntax_realization_after_lineage.ROLE_COMPATIBLE: Exactly one candidate parser realization in the lineage region has the frozen syntax_kind.
syntax_realization_after_lineage.ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE: The lineage region is present and parseable but no candidate realization has the frozen syntax_kind.

token_and_parser_projection.comments_and_trivia: excluded from all lineage signatures; comment contents may never satisfy an exact or context witness
token_and_parser_projection.docstrings: excluded as semantic/context features; a language parser may retain their spans only to prevent accidental matching inside them

lexical_key.identifiers: IDENTIFIER:sha256(raw UTF-8 lexeme); equality is opaque content equality only and never semantic identity
lexical_key.keywords_operators_punctuation: grammar token kind plus grammar-defined lexeme/category
lexical_key.literals: LITERAL_KIND:sha256(raw UTF-8 lexeme); equality is opaque content equality only
lexical_key.source_coordinates: provenance only; never a similarity score or execution authority

token_and_parser_projection.structural_fingerprint: Ordered parser node-kind tree with identifier/literal payload erased, source coordinates erased, comments/docstrings erased, and operator payload normalized to grammar family; arity and child roles/order are retained.

witness_channels.input: frozen anchor slice bytes plus candidate parsed code spans
witness_channels.rule: Collect candidate parser regions whose code span bytes exactly equal the frozen anchor slice. Matches wholly inside comments, docstrings, or literal payloads are not candidates.

witness_channels.input: frozen minimal unique lexical boundary pair
witness_channels.rule: Find all ordered occurrences of the left/right boundary token sequences in candidate code-token space. The tokens between each pair define an edit envelope; map it to the minimal parser region containing the envelope when one exists, otherwise retain a composite or zero-width region.

witness_channels.input: frozen minimal unique alpha boundary pair
witness_channels.rule: Same as W2 over alpha_key tokens. Alpha matching may support transport but cannot by itself authorize PRESENT because collisions are expected after normalization.
Collect candidate parser nodes with exactly the same normalized structural fingerprint, independent of identifier/literal spelling and source position.
Collect candidate occurrences of the same normalized surrounding structure with one wildcard descendant at the frozen HOLE child relation; the wildcard span is the candidate lineage region.
